changes.title: Island lakes
items: Islands from phase 1 have lakes: a few areas of water, never by home, with small shores where the forest floor runs down into the water (no beaches)
Lake water is a lighter blue than the sea, with the stars and the moon in it, and some lakes have big koi, about the size of a baby animal
You can fly over a lake in the treetops but can't land on it; on foot you stop at the shore, and so do the animals, who walk round

changes.title: Chart real islands
items: The sea chart draws every island as it really is: its true shape, its hills lit by the moon, each area in its own ground colour, sandy beaches
Islands and sigils on the sea chart are much bigger: zoom in close on one island to see its full rune circle, or out to see almost the whole sea with every sigil still readable

changes.title: Friendly wave
items: An area whose legend's quest you've done no longer turns on you when its wave comes: its animals stay friendly, so the night can always be won
